args.intro: I hear you loud and clear, my guy—when body and spirit dey feel somehow, loud club bangers na the last thing you need. Here are five soft, moody, and deeply soothing tunes to help you unwind and cool your mind tonight.

picks.why: Tems delivers a moody, smooth alté record with gentle tempo and restrained energy that gives your mind space to breathe.
Omah Lay pours out raw emotion on this melancholic afro-fusion gem, capturing that exact feeling when you need soothing music to take the weight away.
Summer Walker and SZA float across a smooth, low-key R&B groove that keeps the atmosphere peaceful and far from any noisy party rush.
Tay Iwar brings silky, warm alté chords and relaxed, dreamy melodies designed to settle your thoughts and quiet your space.
Brent Faiyaz delivers a subdued, melancholic R&B slow burner with minimal beats and introspective vocals tailored for late-night solace.
